test_duplicate_param_name: test that googletest warns when a parameterized test has a duplicate name
run_test_exit_code_check: run the test binary and verify it terminates by signal with expected error output
assert_condition: assert a condition and raise AssertionError if the condition is false
get_test_executable_path: get the path to a compiled googletest binary by its name
review_subprocess_output: review the subprocess output to verify it contains the duplicate test name error
